blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas is knocking on the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball Final Four door, and the Growling Tigers know they must focus on their own games as the semifinal race heats up. Following the squad’s 89-84 win that eliminated Ateneo on Sunday at Smart Araneta Coliseum, assistant coach Peter Martin was quick to acknowledge the UST’s newfound focus.
